data.text:
Aqueel Habib Shaikh vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another
on 26 August, 2024 
Author: Shivkumar Dige
Bench: Shivkumar Dige
 1
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
 27 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1465 Of 2024
 Aqueel Habib Shaikh
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Another
 ...
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Suhas P. Urgunde
 App for Respondents / State : Mr. C. V. Badane
 ...
 Coram : Shivkumar Dige, J.
 Date : 26.08.2024 
PER COURT :
1. Heard the learned counsel for the applicant. 
2. Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 04.09.2024. The learned A.P.P. waives service on behalf of respondents / State. 
3. In the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with FIR No.0153 of 2024 registered with Daultabad Police Station, District Aurangabad (City), for the offences punishable under Sections 325 read with 3(5) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Section 5A, 5B, 5C, 6, 9 of Animal Preservation Act and under Section 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, he be released on executing personal bond of Rs.20,000/- with one surety in the like amount. The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when required and shall co-operate in the investigation.
